audited_triplets.critique: The Reserve Bank of India issues the JUL22 RBI circular.
The circular requires NBFCs to constitute Grievance Redressal Machinery.
The requirement applies to NBFCs.
The circular requires all NBFCs to display contact details of the Grievance Redressal Officer.
The requirement applies to all NBFCs.
The circular requires the designated officer to ensure prompt redressal of grievances.
The requirement applies to the designated officer.
The circular requires NBFCs' Grievance Redressal Machinery to deal with issues related to outsourced services.
The requirement applies to NBFCs, not a generic 'Regulated Person Or Entity'.

corrected_triplet.description: Requirement applies to NBFCs.
corrected_triplet.exact_quote: It shall be clearly indicated that NBFCs' Grievance Redressal Machinery will also deal with the issue relating to services provided by the outsourced agency.

audited_triplets.critique: The circular permits a time limit of 30 days for customers to file complaints.
The requirement applies to customers, not 'Days'.

corrected_triplet.description: Requirement applies to customers.
corrected_triplet.exact_quote: Generally, a time limit of 30 days may be given to the customers for preferring their complaints/ grievances.

audited_triplets.critique: The circular requires NBFCs to place their grievance redressal procedure and time frame on their website.
The requirement applies to NBFCs, not 'For Responding To The Complaints'.

corrected_triplet.description: Requirement applies to NBFCs.
corrected_triplet.exact_quote: The grievance redressal procedure of the NBFC and the time frame fixed for responding to the complaints shall be placed on the NBFC's website.
